title: Asymmetric uniqueness sets in $\ell^q$
summary: We exhibit an asymmetry phenomenon for uniqueness sets in $\ell^q$. Specifically, we construct sets that do not support measures with $\ell^q$-summable Fourier coefficients, yet simultaneously support measures whose positive frequencies decay faster than polynomials. In the language of Fourier uniqueness, this highlights a striking divergence between the unilateral and bilateral $\ell^q$ uniqueness problems.
